proposals.content:
We want to produce 30 copies of a 7” vinyl featuring two versions of an original song.
This collectible record brings our music into the physical world — a tangible bridge between tradition and remix culture.
It's the continuation of a journey: _Palomas y Cordajes_ vynil was first released during our 2024 Japan Tour and sold out.
Now, with the support of Lil Nouns, we’re relaunching this unique piece for our global community.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmWhkbJ1nks7JiTRC9X9VakwFkzrfUdJTGH5vW8tC1rQ6R)
**🕊️The story behind the song**

In 1950s Buenos Aires, a crackling radio transmission played a soulful tango.
Decades later, we, _Dúo Dø_, tuned into that memory and reimagined it — writing lyrics, weaving a narrative, and crafting a song where vintage echoes blend with contemporary emotion.
Now, thanks to Lil Nouns, we’ll transform this story into a handcrafted physical artifact:
A ritual of listening.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmV7TkBXwkmCL4Gthh6x4qWg1rEcmFsmSA61tSKCkpQU9Q)
**🎧 What you’ll hear on the vinyl**

**💽Side A: **[Link](https://youtu.be/QBvtF0kQTRY)

An acoustic version recorded in Tokyo, Japan, with special guest Gaku-san — stripped down, full of air and soul.

### 💿Side B: [Link](https://youtu.be/K4_Q-f4whCs?si=ytGhqrp88QgZutKg)

The full studio version, recorded in Buenos Aires — nostalgic and cinematic.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmcQVotk2vznXbmxkrd6uz4cYoycc4Gi31rKLbm83zbdQm)
🎨**Cover Art**

Designed by Renso Barbero, who reimagines _fileteado porteño_ — Buenos Aires’ traditional ornamental art — with a bold, contemporary lens.
As our music remixes sonic heritage, Renso’s visual style remixes cultural identity.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmTqfeWpG3MXFVvErZhN5zvnZjNRvDmh9bJkzZRRCoyBtH)
**⌐◨-◨ Nounish by nature**
This vinyl is part of our **2025 ROADMAP**, where each step blends art, identity, and community.
It’s nounish at its core — cross-cultural, handmade, playful, and full of feeling.

This roadmap was made possible thanks to the support of** Nouns via Flows**.
View our profile here: [Link](https://flows.wtf/item/0x97e0a9adaf6fd83b10c568d83f932150102c4e65d9df259514a8a9199dda20e7)

With that grant, we were able to **commission an artist**, bring new characters to life, and organize **several shows — both digitally and IRL**.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmSMAUnZLXkWSxiBgNTJHobqvTiMsLtbQfgciHtKQcVa7S)
🎁**Extras for holders**

Each copy will include exclusive stickers — from the iconic noogles to the characters of our roadmap — bringing the nouniverse into fan hands.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmfHaUfoAZeENR2YVwugmpi9Puk8rRajTUTAaoTFkgafVR)
**🖐️Hand-assembled with care**

Each vinyl will be manually assembled and numbered — transforming it into a unique art object that deepens the collector's emotional connection.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmUgjP1PtkiAZ1iDUZyr7oePaqaWZPy8EQMNNgkpc4ujGf)![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmUgjP1PtkiAZ1iDUZyr7oePaqaWZPy8EQMNNgkpc4ujGf)![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/Qme4DqPsY814Y1Hrru4UD7ZrFUdYaTD3RMKKqttZv1VSxu)
**🔁 How this expands Lil Nouns**
This project brings Lil Nouns into the hands, ears, and hearts of new communities.
The **back cover will feature the iconic noggles in the credits** — a visible, lasting tribute to the DAO that made this possible.

The vinyl will be distributed to collectors and music lovers worldwide — many of whom will be encountering Lil Nouns for the first time.

We’ll **spread the word through live shows, Xspaces, Farcaster, and Discord.**

As active members of **MúsicaW3** ([link](https://x.com/Musica_W3)) — a Latin American network of musicians building in Web3 — we’ll also teach and guide fellow artists on how they too can engage with Nouns to enhance their music.
We’ll document the process and host an onboarding meetup at **Fundación Blockchain Argentina**, inviting others to imagine how their own music and culture can join the movement.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmdAyaQMqLkyxZzVWkZPSmWyVdFJkBjoCPZw7Zv7RUz9vN)
**✨ Commemorative NFT for Lil Nouns holders**

To mark this collaboration, we’ll release a **commemorative NFT**, exclusively for Lil Nouns holders.
This digital collectible will celebrate the link between the physical record and the DAO that made it possible — a meaningful gesture of gratitude, minted with love.

We’re currently exploring platforms like **Manifold**, but we’re open to community input to shape this together.

If selected, we see this commemorative NFT as a meaningful way to connect more deeply with the Lil Nouns community — a chance to learn, share, and build together.

This project unfolds in three layers:

1. The **handcrafted vinyl** is an internal, artistic process — our own ritual of creation.
2. The **NFT vinyl collection** is about outreach — a way to share this work with our global community.
3. And the **commemorative NFT** is a shared moment — an opportunity to decide together _how and where_ it should be distributed, in dialogue with the Lil Nouns community.

💸** Budget: 0.2 ETH**

To be used for:

- Vinyl pressing
- Cover printing
- Sticker production
- Assembly and packaging

The vinyl will be completed within 60 days.
After that, we’ll launch two digital components:

- The **NFT Vinyls collection** for our global community
- And the **commemorative NFT** for Lil Nouns holders

proposals.content:
🖼️We’re bringing **Lil Nouns to life** — literally — with a **large-scale mural** at our Nounish Art School in Trujillo, Peru.

But here’s the twist:

🎨🧑‍🎨👩‍🎨 **It will be painted by dozens of  kids **— students from our school and children from the local community.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmcqV1VMYoSeZoVF1R8BJ56QQ498CAZsMJXLc1jBQUTAVA)Some lil artist 

Our team artist Claudio will design a playful, black-and-white Lil Nounish illustration — a giant coloring page on a wall. Kids will be invited to fill it with color, joy, and their imagination.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmPRSRQc2boLNmz1BijxA9msCAg9Kwy77aRSextmXwpZUj)

📲We’ll also mint the mural as a 1/1 NFT on Zora, immortalizing it on-chain. A QR code and URL will be placed next to the mural, connecting the physical piece to its digital twin.

This isn’t just a mural. It’s a participatory, permanent work of Nounish art by joy. 

⸻

🖼️ What We’ll Do With the Funding:

  •  Host an Open Paint Day(200 visitors aprox) registered via Unlock 

  •  Gift each kid participant a custom certificate + Nounish goodies

  •  Mint the mural as a 1/1 NFT on Zora

  •  Place a QR code and shortlink beside the mural

  •  Print and distribute stickers with the mural + NFT link

  •  Involve the community: we’ll share the mural sketch for feedback from Lil Nouns holders before the painting day! and we will do onboarding content before, during and after the BIG DAY, with blogs and more!

⸻

📌 Why It Matters

  •  Fun, joyful, and deeply Nounish: Kids, paint, public art, NFTs ✨

  •  Expands Lil Nouns IRL — a new canvas for culture

  •  Creates a bridge between digital and physical creativity

  •  Teaches kids about web3 through a hands-on, positive experience

⸻

🧰 What We’ve Done So Far

We run the Nounish Art School IRL in Trujillo, Peru —  So far, we’ve:

  •  We have provided full art scholarships to dozens of youth and children

  •  Painted collaborative murals with students and local artists

  •  Hosted web3 art workshops and on-chain minting lessons

  •  Organized the Global Pizza Party (3 cities across Peru!)

  •  Built a mini onboarding app on Farcaster for emerging artists

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmS3M4jPc4yMYtFKdh3KtCuNpP1MRFtf3983zw3NEEp5Wq)_Collage made by @0xmonografia_

We live and breathe Nounish creativity — and this project is a natural next step.

⸻

📅 Timeline

  •  Month 1: Community feedback + mural design prep

  •  Month 2: Open Paint Day! + NFT mint on Zora

  •  Month 3: Sticker drop + content recap (photos/video)

⸻

# Art Workshop: Painting the Meme for All to See

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmboQDkf5G3H3CSJG6jwo8B5CgoPjFQf5PyYngdmguYYCx)

## Proposal

An art workshop for children aged 7 to 12 to paint their own versions of Lil Nouns on personalized canvases. 

The activity also introduces the Lil Nouns community to parents, families, and local residents, bringing everyone closer to Nounish culture in a fun and creative way. Taking place in a welcoming, open space, the workshop invites passersby to watch the action and feel curious about what’s happening.

Place: Búzios - Brazil, surrounded by nature. 

## How the children will be selected

Spots are limited and participants (around 10+ kids) ) will be selected through an online registration form.

## How the workshop works

- Each child receives: 

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmSHSECk6qYEutq2EUkgAsquwyiPfGS62YoFB58DSrB2d7)

- The experience includes a snack break for the kids.

- At the end, each child takes everything home, their artwork, easel, canvas, apron, remaining materials and their Lil Nouns Artist Certificate.  

## How this idea helps spread the Lil Nouns meme

- Brings Lil Nouns into the real world by engaging kids and families in a playful, offline art experience.

- Taking place in a welcoming, open space, the workshop invites everyone nearby to pause and engage with the creative process.

- In a small town like Búzios, events like this tend to stand out,  making the workshop a natural topic of conversation among locals.

- Creates shareable photos and artworks to boost visibility on X and Farcaster, all documented online for the Lil Nouns community to see, enjoy and share.

- Activates local networks and expands reach beyond the crypto-native audience.

LILNOUNS⌐◨-◨

# “Lil Nouns, Big Stage”

# -A RoseCity Web3 x Harmony Lab Co. Artist Showcase & Auction-

### 🧠 TL;DR:

We’re proposing a live and livestreamed **Lil Nouns-centered artist showcase and auction** that serves three purposes:

1. **Celebrate and elevate the Lil Nouns public domain artwork** by featuring it in physical + digital art forms
2. **Host a special Lil Nouns auction (on-chain) to seed RoseCity Nouns’ treasury**
3. **Use local art, music, and spoken word to create a vibe-heavy community event** that puts Lil Nouns directly in front of artists, collectors, and creatives

This proposal brings the weird, the heart, and the narrative-forward energy Lil Nouns is known for — while catalyzing a new city node of Nouns culture.

## ✨ What We’re Proposing

A high-impact, collaborative **artist showcase and Lil Nouns auction event** produced by RoseCity Web3 and Harmony Lab Co. in Portland, Oregon.

- **Feature local artists reinterpreting Lil Nouns art** across mediums (painting, digital, sculpture, audio-reactive installations)
- **Host an IRL + livestreamed Lil Nouns auction** to start the RoseCity Nouns treasury
- **Bring attention to the public domain nature of Lil Nouns**, onboarding new artists to the DAO ecosystem
- **Celebrate Lil Nouns as muse, meme, and movement**, not just a project
- Integrate **interactive Lil Noun stations**, generative art booths, and storytelling sessions to educate newcomers on Nounish culture

## 🎯 Why This Is Especially For Lil Nouns

Lil Nouns DAO has always embraced weird, open, expressive culture. This proposal embodies that spirit in full:

- **All artwork created for the event will be Lil Nouns inspired** and clearly attributed to the DAO
- Artists will retain creative freedom **within the Lil Nouns visual and cultural universe**
- **A portion of proceeds from the physical art sales will be donated back to the Lil Nouns treasury or ecosystem grants**
- We’ll include **a printed and digital zine** that tells the story of Lil Nouns in street-level, poetic terms - for creatives who don’t speak "crypto"
- **The Lil Nouns auction itself will be the centerpiece of the evening**, streamed to audiences globally

This isn’t just using Lil Nouns as a theme- it’s about making Lil Nouns the patron of a whole new art wave.

## 🌍 Local Benefits (Bonus Round)

The benefits to our Portland creative community are easy to see:

- Support and visibility for local BIPOC and queer artists
- An experimental testbed for art x DAO convergence
- Education about public domain IP, on-chain governance, and creative rights
- A way to turn culture into capital for social good, aligning with RoseCity DAO’s broader mission of art, justice, and regeneration

But we want to be clear: **Lil Nouns benefits more.** We are creating the event around them. **This is a love letter to open source culture — and Lil Nouns is the star.**

## 🪙 What We’re Asking For

**0.2 ETH** to help cover:

- Artist materials for Lil Nouns visual reinterpretations
- AV and livestreaming to broadcast the Lil Nouns auction + art to the world
- Light marketing and promotional zine focused on Lil Nouns narrative + visuals
- Refreshments and rentals to make the event inviting and immersive

All final costs will be transparently posted in Discord, and updates shared along the way.

## 📅 Timeline

- **Event Date:** Within 45–90 days of funding (targeting late August or early September 2025) GOAL is to secure a few other sponsors to match funding
- **Location:** TBD
- **Follow-ups:** Full recap, photo album, and artist statements published within 3 weeks of event

## ❤️ Why This Fits Lil Nouns

Lil Nouns was made to spark creativity, remix culture, and empower everyday people to do extraordinary things. That’s what we’re doing, together, and with heart.

This isn’t just an event.
It’s a bridge between the chain and the street.

And Lil Nouns holds the keys.⌐◨-◨

Last year, my mom, who owns a small pulpería named Pulpería Flora, decided to add a unique twist to the celebration. Inspired by the versatility and adaptability of Nouns, we personalized cakes and piñatas with a Nounish style, bringing a touch of Web3 to the festivities. My good friend Karla helped me customize everything, hand out candy bags, and support the celebration. It was a lot of work for just three people, but the joy it brought to the kids made it all worth it.

A tradition filled with music, laughter, and the classic Honduran dish, arroz con pollo (rice with chicken).

Little bags of candies (confites) for every child.

A delicious Nounish-themed cake and a piñata to top it all off. This celebration is something my mom organizes every year, but in 2024, we decided to make it Nounish with the help of my friend Karla (@kohm). It was a day to remember, and it sparked the idea for something bigger.

**The Story:**
I'm Felipe Flip, a Brazilian musician who's been bridging street culture and Web3 through my SensatioNouns project. I'm the son of a Nigerian father, born in São Paulo's periphery, and I've spent years using music to connect communities that society often keeps apart.

**What I Want to Do:**
Two free concerts over two months, each featuring my band performing Brazilian Popular Music (MPB) reimagined through rock and rap - all genres born from Black culture and favela creativity. Think bossa nova meets hardcore, samba rhythms with Web3 education.

**Why This Matters:**
Each month, 100 people from São Paulo's periphery will experience something they've never had access to:

- **1 hour live show** blending MPB, bossa nova, rock & rap
- **2 hours DJ set** keeping the energy alive
- **1 hour Web3 education**
- onboarding, wallets, blockchain basics
- **Free noggles stickers & event NFTs** for everyone

**The Venues:**
**we can do it at:**

- Nouns House SP (community hub)
- Bless Skateshop (skate culture crossover)
- Rock Toghether Studio (audiovisual documentation)
- Mindhunters Studio (audiovisual documentation)

**Why Lil Nouns Should Care:**
This isn't just another concert series. This is cultural revolution disguised as a party. I'm taking Web3 knowledge to people who can't afford $50 workshops or exclusive events. I'm proving that nounish values - doing good, creating positive externalities, embracing difference - work best when they're set to a beat that makes your soul move.

**The Real Talk:**
I need 0.1 ETH per show (0.2 ETH total) to cover production, equipment, venue costs, and those precious noggles stickers that'll be someone's first touch of this community.

**What You'll Get:**

- 200 new people introduced to Web3 through music
- Content documenting every moment for the community
- Proof that street culture + blockchain = magic
- Two months of pure nounish energy in Brazil's biggest city

**The Promise:**
In 60 days, I'll have turned parking lots, skate shops, or street corners into Web3 classrooms where the curriculum is taught through bass lines and the graduation ceremony is everyone wearing noggles together.

This is SensatioNouns. This is how we build the future - one beat at a time.

_Let's make some noise that matters._

**Project Summary:**
This project proposes the creation of 30 unique digital drawings of my crush, Lee, as a persistent and creative expression of my affection. Each drawing will be distinct, reflecting different aspects of her personality, shared experiences, or my feelings for her. The project will culminate in a presentation of the completed collection to Her, with the hope that the dedication and artistry will inspire a positive response.

**Funding Request:** 0.2 ETH

This funding will cover the cost of:

- **Software & Resources:** Access to necessary digital art software and resources.
- **Tools:** Drawing Tablet or Android Tablet
- **Time Commitment:** Compensation for the significant time investment required to create 30 high-quality digital drawings.

**Expected Outcome:**
The project's success will be measured by the completion of the 30 drawings and, ideally, a positive response from her. The collection of drawings will serve as a unique and memorable testament to my affection, regardless of the outcome. The project will be documented and shared online, potentially generating interest and engagement.

**Why this project is worthwhile:**
This project represents a unique and creative approach to expressing romantic interest. It goes beyond simple gestures and demonstrates a significant commitment to the pursuit of a relationship. The resulting artwork will be a valuable personal asset and could potentially gain online traction. The reduced number of drawings allows for a more manageable project scope while still conveying significant dedication.
